  Scenario: AC7 The business rules of section 8 hold across the contract (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the contract of this story and the business rules of section 8
    When the contract is reviewed against BR1 to BR12
    Then the resolve is side-effect free, the read composes it and the fill writes only through rwb-case, and this service writes no case column, task row or lock (BR1, BR2)
    Then only /api/recovery/integration/v1 and the task queue rwb-integration are declared as this service's own (BR3)
    Then the catalog is read only through RuleCatalog.row(ruleId, packageVersion), the kit supplies RuleResult and NoPackageInForce, and no second rule engine runs in this service (BR4, BR5)
    Then action text, owner role, timer, role class, service level and calendar are read through their owners' contracts and written in no code path (BR6)
    Then the same case facts, catalog row, reference rows and business date give the same resolve answer (BR7)
    Then a fill raises at most one open NEXT_ACTION_MISSING task per case, and the Schedule carries the overlap policy SKIP and a catch-up window (BR8)
    Then events, activity inputs, examples and fakes carry no personal data (BR9)
    Then a consumed field, path or error that no source fixes carries the placeholder with one gap row and its assumption rows (BR10)
    Then rwb.casewf.next-action is a feature flag of the platform flag library and no column of a service table (BR11)
    Then the package version "RES-2026.12" and the rows R-RES-04, R-SET-13, R-RES-03, R-DEV-05 and R-RES-07 are carried unchanged (BR12)
